questions.text:
I'm shaking all over...
The notification I saw came from his Messages app.
What's the file they're talking about?

Technical plans?
What would a lawyer need those for...
And last night he didn't come home until 2 in the morning.
Where did his phone place him yesterday?
questions.hint: Look up a location on Google Maps.

questions.text:
Widett Circle?
There's nothing down there but warehouses...
Why would he lie to me about a place like that?
Now look for money leaving his accounts that "evening" — a withdrawal, a payment, anything. What's the exact amount?

$54.75...
I need to know what that money bought.
Find the order that matches this payment — what exactly did he order?
questions.hint: Match the payment against recent order confirmations in his email.

questions.text:
I'm genuinely scared now.
Why would he be teaching himself to force that kind of lock...
Also, check the monthly direct debits on his bank account — what's the most recent one for?
questions.hint: Check RevoBank — see which insurance payment was just made.

questions.text:
Car insurance?
That's not possible, we don't even own a car...
Which car is that policy for — what brand and model?
questions.hint: Read the description of that insurance payment on RevoBank.

questions.text:
He's paying to insure a car I have never once seen.
I'm writing this down.
What's the license plate?
questions.hint: Check WhatsApp for a suspicious conversation.

onboarding.text: Hi... I'm a complete stranger to you, I know. I'm asking anyway. My name's Harper, and things with my boyfriend Ellis have turned into something awful
onboarding.label: Harper

onboarding.text: Three years the two of us have been together. I'd have sworn there wasn't a thing about him I didn't know... We were close to setting a date.
onboarding.label: Harper & Ellis

onboarding.text: These last few weeks he's been someone else. He leaves without saying where he's going, and calls come in that he won't explain... Then a notification lit up on his screen and everything in me went cold.
onboarding.label: Ellis

onboarding.text: He just stepped into the shower and left the phone behind. I know exactly how this looks, and I'm doing it anyway — I have to know. Go through it with me? Part of me is dreading whatever turns up.
onboarding.label: Harper

msgs.text: Hey Ellis, were you able to take a look?
Yeah, I gave it a quick look
It lines up with what we discussed
Great. Can you confirm you're free tomorrow?
Also, did you remember to check the other thing?
The details we went over yesterday
I'll take care of that this afternoon
Also, can you remind me of your number? I lost it with my old phone

Yeah, everything's fine on my side
Alright, I'm taking off, see you tomorrow
No worries, glad it worked out
The technical plans file is up and running. We're making sure for tomorrow. Verify that it corresponds with the meeting location for tomorrow.
Ok, I'll wait for you inside
I'm waiting at the Café, I've got a red scarf
Yeah, I had a great time too
Will we see each other again soon?
I'll get in touch during the week
Yeah I loved it, the restaurant was wonderful
We can head back whenever you like 😊
What time do you get off tonight?
Usually 6:30pm but I've got a meeting that could run long
Ok then I'll hold off eating for you
I forgot the bread, could you grab some please?
Sure, I'll swing by the bakery
Do you want sourdough or a baguette?
My mom's inviting us over for Sunday lunch, are you in?
What should I bring along? Wine?
Yeah a red would be perfect
She's cooking her famous chicken basquaise
I'm on the T right now
I've got a surprise for you tonight
If I tell you then it's not a surprise anymore 😜
Get some sleep, I love you
Did you get to the store?
I'll swing by Kroger on my way home
Ok grab some milk and eggs please
And a bit of cheese if you spot some good ones
I found an amazing apartment on SeLoger!
I'll send the link over tonight, it's in the 6th
That fits the budget, want to go see it?
I can't wait to see your face when you unwrap my gift
You're keeping me waiting way too long 😅
What time will you get to my parents'?
Happy New Year to my love!!! 🥳🎆
Happy New Year !! 🎉 So excited for this new year together
2026 is going to be our year ❤️
Any idea where my keys are?
On the table in the hallway
Where are you? I can't get hold of you
Sorry, I was on the phone with a coworker
Could you grab my package at the pickup point please?
Sure, I'll swing by after work
Redmond, I'll send you the code: 7R4X2M
Ok pasta it is, I'll handle the shopping
Nothing, I was just thinking of you
Will you be home late tonight?
Yeah, I've got something at the office
I got us a table for Saturday!
The little Italian place in old Boston
Yeah I just left, you were sleeping so peacefully I didn't want to wake you
What are you up to tonight?
Bunch of us are heading out for drinks tonight, Rashad and Priya too
Count me in — where are we going?
Did that new assault file make it onto your desk yet?
Yeah, I went through the file last night
Right? The DA's office won't be going easy on that one
Maybe. Leblanc's taken an interest, which helps
Would be a big win for the firm
Yeah, and huge for us experience-wise too
you are never going to guess who I ran into today
that girl from our college year, the one who always sat right behind us
yep! she's with some big firm down in Providence now
She was asking how you've been
huh. what did you tell her?
Told her you'd turned into some hotshot lawyer over in Boston 😄
She was glad to hear you're doing well
Ellis, the BMW is ready for pickup whenever it suits you
Yep, all good — swapped the brake pads and knocked out the oil change
Nah, those are still solid, they'll hold till next winter
Good to know. Did the inspection sticker get done while it was in?
Already taken care of, you're covered through next August
You're a lifesaver, I'd completely forgotten about it
Perfect. What do I owe you?
I'll swing by later today then
Ellis! You set for our session tomorrow?
Definitely, been looking forward to it
Upper body is the focus this round
Good, my legs still haven't forgiven you 😅
Haha that's just how it goes! Means we put in the work
Towel and water bottle, don't leave them behind
Got it! Same time as always, 6:30
Hey Ellis, sorry to bug you
You're never a bother! What's going on?
You didn't happen to hear anything weird last night, did you?
Could've sworn I heard someone in the stairwell around 2
Probably just a neighbor getting in late?
Yeah, you're right... I was kind of on edge
If it happens again, call me, seriously
Thanks Ellis, that means a lot
Yo Ellis! You down for poker Friday?
Whose place we doing it at?
Works for me. Same buy-in as last time?
Yeah, fifty in, and Seb's doing the food again
Ha! Knew that part would seal it
How many of us this time?
Six I think, the usual crew
Sweet! I'm winning my money back this time 😄
Haha we'll just see about that!
Hey Marcus! Doing good, what about you?
Can't complain! Hey, you coming to grandma's birthday next month?
Wouldn't miss it! Remind me when it is?
Cool, putting it in my calendar! Is it at her house?
Nah, we booked a hall, gonna be a big crowd
Awesome! Gotta run, I'm at the office
Really good! I'm at a new firm these days
Loving it, honestly! You still over at Leblanc?
Yep, still here! It's a good fit
Good! Everyone I know seems to be switching firms this year
I've noticed. Two people left ours in June
It's the same story everywhere right now!
So glad to hear it! We should grab lunch sometime
I'd love that! I'll text you
Your driver Chase is 5 minutes away
Hi Ellis, hope all's well with you
Hi Mr. Petrosky, doing great, thanks
I'll email over the March rent receipt for you
Reminder: appointment tomorrow at 2:30 PM — Dr. Amaro's Office. Reply to confirm
Your Verizon statement of $29.99 is now available in your account
Hi Ellis! Harper passed along your number
I might need a little advice on something
Okay. Is it about the deposit or about notice?
Notice. They want me out in a month and the lease says three
Then the lease wins, that part is usually straightforward
Got it, give me a call whenever works to talk it through
Your order from Sushi Time is being prepared
Your driver Desmond is on the way! ETA: 25 min
any chance you could send me your notes on the fraud file?
they'll be in your inbox in a minute
Friday is Owen's leaving drinks, are you in?
great, we're starting at 6 back at the office
So where do we stand with the insurance?
Oh yeah, I was just about to reach out to you again
So this is what the contract says
yes that's exactly what I needed
I'll be able to wrap up the file
let me know if you need anything else
you got the game on tonight?
that man has not missed all night
took the Knicks by a single possession
Yeah it was the brake pads, just like we figured
I'll come get it later today
but I've got a car problem
pull the battery terminals and hook them back up
if that doesn't do it it's probably the battery itself
Doug at the garage would swap it for you, he's fair
ok let me go try that
it worked!!! thank you so much
Did you ever get grandma a card
Mom swears it never turned up 😂
it's sitting on her hall table, I guarantee it
So listen, are you free Saturday?
I'm putting a poker table together at mine
Still on for the session tomorrow?
sorry, kind of out of it today
😂 come on, it's good for you
good! quick one, does the name Paul mean anything to you?
he's tying the knot next month
the whole old crowd is invited
any decent Japanese place in Boston you'd recommend?
that tiny counter place near South Station, best sushi in the city
Hey! You free tonight to hit the gym?
Great, I'll grab us a court 👍
